description: Serve many stdio MCP servers from one container over HTTPS, with a built-in OAuth 2.1 login
name: io.github.ni-c/mcp-hub

environmentVariables.description: Public base URL exactly as clients see it, e.g. https://mcp.example.net (no path)
environmentVariables.name: EXTERNAL_URL

environmentVariables.description: bcrypt hash of the OAuth login password (htpasswd -bnBC 10 "" 'pw' | tr -d ':\n')
environmentVariables.name: PASSWORD_HASH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the mcp.json listing the servers to expose, in Claude Code's mcpServers format (default /config/mcp.json)
environmentVariables.name: CONFIG_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the JWT key and OAuth client state; must persist across restarts (default /data)
environmentVariables.name: DATA_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs of the reverse proxy allowed to set X-Forwarded-* headers
environmentVariables.name: TRUSTED_PROXIES

title: mcp-hub
